subject.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync

question: Should preinstalled sandbox skills be represented by a backend capability that supplies their readable root, or should OpenClaw accept `agents.*.sandbox.docker.skipSkillsSync` as a permanent public configuration contract?
rationale: The optimization is valid, but choosing a Docker option, a generic sandbox option, or a backend capability determines public configuration and plugin-backend ownership; implementation review cannot safely choose that product boundary.

options.title: Use a backend capability
options.body: Extend the sandbox backend contract to declare prepared skills and their readable root, avoiding a misleading Docker setting and hard-coded location.

options.title: Sponsor a sandbox-level option
options.body: Move the setting out of Docker configuration and define one canonical preinstalled-skill directory that every supporting backend must provide.

options.title: Keep it Docker-only
options.body: Gate the behavior on the Docker backend and require Docker setup or binds to populate the documented canonical skill directory.

recommendation.title: Use a backend capability
recommendation.body: Extend the sandbox backend contract to declare prepared skills and their readable root, avoiding a misleading Docker setting and hard-coded location.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent sandbox backend, configuration, and documentation history best matches this product-boundary choice.
